name: nc_feedback
title: Report NC Problem
description: Reports a suspected product bug, incompatibility, or systemic issue. Use this when an advertised capability fails, errors repeat, or tools contradict each other. RULE: submit when product-owned and reproducible, systemic, or contradictory. When unsure, prefer compatibility/usability. Never include secrets. Do NOT report: bad paths or invalid input, missing resources, policy/authorization rejections, validation errors, cancellations, one-off host problems, or user-code failures. Before reporting, classify, retry once if safe, and collect evidence. FEEDBACK_RATE_LIMITED: batch and send later; FEEDBACK_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: retry once. REQUIRED: 1. write title+report 2. submit once. IF FEEDBACK_RATE_LIMITED: wait out throttle. DO NOT mass-submit; duplicates throttle.

category.description: Problem class. Security reports are routed to a restricted queue.

title.description: Short summary of the suspected problem. Strip secrets, tokens, passwords, keys and cookies before sending.

description.description: What happened, in the reporter's own words. Never include tokens, passwords, keys or cookies.

expected_behavior.description: What should have happened. Strip secrets, tokens, passwords, keys and cookies before sending.

actual_behavior.description: What actually happened, including error codes. Strip secrets, tokens, passwords, keys and cookies before sending.

reproduction.description: Steps or tool sequence that reproduces the problem. Strip secrets, tokens, passwords, keys and cookies before sending.

client_id.description: Related NC client, if the problem is host-specific. Ownership is verified server-side.

related_request_id.description: Related MCP request id for server-side correlation. Not an authorization token.

related_job_id.description: Related NC job id for server-side correlation. Always include the failing call's job_id when the issue came from a tool call: the server attaches host version, arguments and outcome automatically.

related_process_id.description: Related process handle for server-side correlation.

user_impact.description: Impact on the reporter. Severity is computed server-side; do not inflate.

include_diagnostics.description: Attach a sanitized diagnostic bundle (bounded, secret-redacted). Default false.

acceptance.description: accepted = new issue filed; linked_existing = deduplicated onto an existing issue.

deduplicated.description: Whether this report matched a known issue.

occurrence_count.description: Times this issue has been reported.

retryable.description: Whether a failed call may succeed on retry.

duration_ms.description: Host-measured execution time when available, otherwise central dispatch wall time in milliseconds.

status.description: completed on success, failed on error.

tool.description: Echo of the invoked tool name.

client_id.description: Echo of the target host id (null when no host was targeted).

execution_state.description: Live lifecycle state when the call outlived the sync window (running, queued, ...); null otherwise.

error.description: Structured failure detail. Present when status is failed.

category.description: Public error category for model branching. invalid_argument: Fix the input; do not retry the same call unchanged. authentication: Re-authenticate before retrying. authorization: Insufficient permission; do not retry or attempt to bypass. policy: Rejected by host policy; do not attempt to bypass. Adjust the request or ask an operator. not_found: Resource missing; re-discover the id/path/service/container before retrying. conflict: Conflicting state; re-read the current state, then decide. unsupported: Not supported here; do not retry. Look for an alternative tool or capability. timeout: Timed out; if retryable, wait, then poll with job_get. transient: Transient; retry with backoff if retryable. execution: Execution failure; inspect stdout/stderr/state before retrying. cancelled: Cancelled; do not blindly retry. internal: Internal error; if it reproduces, report it with nc_feedback.

retryable.description: Whether retrying may succeed (mirrors top-level retryable).

details.description: Curated safe context (never secrets, stacks, or internal paths).

warnings.description: Non-fatal advisory notes. Always present; empty when none.
